map.为什么用有效值算功率？: Why Use RMS Values for Power?
map.有效值使交流与直流在电阻上产生同功率，是功率等效的直流当量。: The RMS value makes AC and DC dissipate the same power in a resistor — it is the DC equivalent for power purposes.
map.非正弦也除以√2吗？: Do Non-Sine Waves Also Divide by √2?
map.不，√2 仅对正弦成立；其他波形有各自波形因数。: No, the √2 factor only holds for sine waves; other waveforms have their own form factors.
